verdict.rationale: Retell documents per-agent data retention that automatically and permanently deletes call and chat data, including transcripts, recordings, and logs, after a set period for compliance. This covers the retention half of the story. The pack has no evidence of per-call recording on/off controls or of consent or disclosure features. Missing for 10: per-call recording toggle or opt-out controls, recording-consent or disclosure announcement capability, per-call (rather than per-agent) retention granularity, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention

citations.quote: Retell allows you to configure a data retention period per agent. After the retention period expires, call and chat data associated with that agent is automatically and permanently deleted.
Configure per-agent data retention to automatically delete call and chat data — transcripts, recordings, and logs — after a set period for compliance.
